verses.original: אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת וַיֹּ֣סֶף מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ śə·’êṯ way·yō·sep̄ mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Job . . . continued his discourse . . .

verses.original: אֵ֭ל חַי־ הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl ḥay- hê·sîr miš·pā·ṭî wə·šad·day hê·mar nap̄·šî
verses.literal: As surely as God lives who has deprived me of justice the Almighty who has embittered my soul

verses.original: ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י כָל־ בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃ כִּֽי־
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ niš·mā·ṯî ḵāl ḇî wə·rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah bə·’ap·pî kî-
verses.literal: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils -

verses.original: שְׂפָתַ֣י אִם־ תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם־ יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·p̄ā·ṯay ’im- tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh ‘aw·lāh ū·lə·šō·w·nî ’im- yeh·geh rə·mî·yāh
verses.literal: my lips will not speak wickedness and my tongue will not utter deceit

verses.original: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם־ אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם לֹא־ אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃ עַד־ אֶגְוָ֑ע
verses.transliteration: ḥā·lî·lāh lî ’im- ’aṣ·dîq ’eṯ·ḵem lō- ’ā·sîr tum·mā·ṯî mim·men·nî ‘aḏ- ’eḡ·wā‘
verses.literal: I will never - say that you are right - I will maintain . . . my integrity . . . until I die

verses.original: הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ מִיָּמָֽי׃ לְ֝בָבִ֗י לֹֽא־ יֶחֱרַ֥ף
verses.transliteration: he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî wə·lō ’ar·pe·hā mî·yā·māy lə·ḇā·ḇî lō- ye·ḥĕ·rap̄
verses.literal: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go As long as I live my conscience will not accuse me

verses.original: אֹ֣יְבִ֑י יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·yə·ḇî yə·hî ḵə·rā·šā‘ ū·miṯ·qō·wm·mî ḵə·‘aw·wāl
verses.literal: May my enemy be like the wicked and my opponent like the unjust

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה־ תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יֵ֖שֶׁל נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mah- tiq·waṯ ḥā·nêp̄ kî yiḇ·ṣā‘ kî ’ĕ·lō·w·ah yê·šel nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: For what [is] the hope of the godless when he is cut off when God takes away his life

verses.original: אֵ֑ל יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ כִּֽי־ צָרָֽה׃ תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ’êl yiš·ma‘ ha·ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯōw kî- ṣā·rāh ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him

verses.original: יִתְעַנָּ֑ג עַל־ שַׁדַּ֥י יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל־ עֵֽת׃ אִם־
verses.transliteration: yiṯ·‘an·nāḡ ‘al- šad·day yiq·rā ’ĕ·lō·w·ah bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ ’im-
verses.literal: Will he delight in the Almighty Will he call upon God at all times . . .

verses.original: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־ אֵ֑ל לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־ שַׁ֝דַּ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·reh ’eṯ·ḵem bə·yaḏ- ’êl lō ’ă·ḵa·ḥêḏ ’ă·šer ‘i·mō·ša- šad·dai
verses.literal: I will instruct you in the power of God I will not conceal the ways of . . . the Almighty

verses.original: הֵן־ כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם אַתֶּ֣ם וְלָמָּה־ זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hên- kul·lə·ḵem ḥă·zî·ṯem ’at·tem wə·lām·māh- zeh he·ḇel teh·bā·lū
verses.literal: Surely all of you have seen [it] for yourselves Why then do you keep up this empty talk . . .

verses.original: זֶ֤ה׀ רָשָׁ֥ע׀ אָדָ֖ם חֵֽלֶק־ עִם־ אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים יִקָּֽחוּ׃ מִשַּׁדַּ֥י
verses.transliteration: zeh rā·šā‘ ’ā·ḏām ḥê·leq- ‘im- ’êl wə·na·ḥă·laṯ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm yiq·qā·ḥū miš·šad·day
verses.literal: This [is] the wicked man’s portion from God the heritage the ruthless receive from the Almighty

verses.original: אִם־ בָנָ֣יו יִרְבּ֣וּ לְמוֹ־ חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḇā·nāw yir·bū lə·mōw- ḥā·reḇ wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’āw lō yiś·bə·‘ū- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Though his sons are many they are destined for the sword and his offspring will never have enough food

verses.original: שְׂרִידוֹ יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ בַּמָּ֣וֶת וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·rī·ḏō yiq·qā·ḇê·rū bam·mā·weṯ wə·’al·mə·nō·ṯāw lō ṯiḇ·ke·nāh
verses.literal: His survivors will be buried by the plague and their widows will not weep for them

verses.original: אִם־ יִצְבֹּ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף כֶּעָפָ֣ר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃ וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר
verses.transliteration: ’im- yiṣ·bōr kā·sep̄ ke·‘ā·p̄ār yā·ḵîn mal·būš wə·ḵa·ḥō·mer
verses.literal: Though he heaps up silver like dust and piles up a wardrobe like clay

verses.original: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף יַחֲלֹֽק׃ נָקִ֥י
verses.transliteration: yā·ḵîn wə·ṣad·dîq yil·bāš wə·ḵe·sep̄ ya·ḥă·lōq nā·qî
verses.literal: what he lays up the righteous will wear and his silver will be divided by the innocent

verses.original: בֵּית֑וֹ בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ṯōw bā·nāh ḵā·‘āš ū·ḵə·suk·kāh ‘ā·śāh nō·ṣêr
verses.literal: The house he built is like a moth’s cocoon like a hut set up by a watchman

verses.original: יִ֭שְׁכַּב עָשִׁ֣יר וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף פָּקַ֣ח עֵינָ֖יו וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·kaḇ ‘ā·šîr wə·lō yê·’ā·sêp̄ pā·qaḥ ‘ê·nāw wə·’ê·nen·nū
verses.literal: He lies down wealthy but will do so no more . . . when he opens his eyes all is gone

verses.original: בַּלָּה֑וֹת תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם סוּפָֽה׃ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ לַ֝֗יְלָה
verses.transliteration: bal·lā·hō·wṯ taś·śî·ḡê·hū ḵam·ma·yim sū·p̄āh gə·nā·ḇat·tū lay·lāh
verses.literal: Terrors overtake him like a flood a tempest sweeps him away in the night

verses.original: קָדִ֣ים יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·ḏîm yiś·śā·’ê·hū wə·yê·laḵ wî·śā·‘ă·rê·hū mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: The east wind carries him away and he is gone it sweeps him out of his place

verses.original: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃ מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·yaš·lêḵ ‘ā·lāw wə·lō yaḥ·mōl bā·rō·w·aḥ yiḇ·rāḥ mî·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong . . . from its power

verses.original: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·pōq ḵap·pê·mōw ‘ā·lê·mōw wə·yiš·rōq ‘ā·lāw mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: It claps its hands at him and hisses him out of his place
